name: ged-mono
description: GedCode + GedPi monorepo: the Ged workflow layer for OpenCode and Pi

scripts.check: npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run check --prefix packages/gedpi
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --prefix packages/gedpi
scripts.verify: npm --prefix packages/gedpi run verify && npm -w packages/gedcode run check && npm -w packages/gedcode test
